description: Running out of storage on your iPhone can be frustrating. Deleting photos helps to free up some storage. Instead, you can clear app caches, message attachments, duplicate system files and other data that quietly accumulates over time. In this article, we will guide you through ways to manage iPhone storage without permanently deleting your photos.
title: How to Free Up iPhone Storage Without Deleting Photos

description: Annual prepaid plans with 365 days of validity can be a convenient option for regular users. title: Jio vs Airtel vs Vi: Best Plans With 365 Days Validity Compared

description: Many Android brands are selling handsets in the Rs. 30,000 segment with advanced camera features. The Redmi Note 15 Pro and Motorola Edge 70 Fusion stand out for their 200-megapixel primary cameras. The Nothing Phone 3a Pro has a triple rear camera unit with a dedicated telephoto camera and optical zoom. Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro 5G also features a triple-camera system.
title: Best Camera Phones Under Rs. 30,000 in India: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro 5G, Motorola Edge 70 Fusion, More

description: Motorola, Realme, Nothing, iQOO, and Vivo launched multiple phones under Rs. 50,000 with AMOLED displays. The Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ is equipped with a 6.8-inch 1.5K (1,272 x 2,772 pixels) Extreme AMOLED display. The Nothing Phone (4a) Pro boasts a 6.83-inch 1.5K (1,260 x 2,800 pixels) AMOLED display that refreshes at up to 144Hz. The Realme P4s 5G sports a 6.78-inch 1.5K (1,272 x 2,772 pixels) AMOLED display, with Samsung M14 luminescent material. The Vivo S2 and iQOO Z11 feature a 6.83-inch 1.5K (1,260 x 2,800 pixels) 3D Curved AMOLED display.
title: Best AMOLED Display Phones Under Rs. 50,000: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+, Nothing Phone (4a) Pro and More

description: The smartphone market has become a little strange lately. Phones that once felt like obvious value-for-money picks are getting more expensive. This is primarily due to the rising cost of memory and storage components, which, in turn, is pushing manufacturers to either hike prices or compromise on hardware. The sub-Rs. 40,000 price bracket has taken one of the biggest hits. Historically known for having bang-for-your-buck devices, the segment is becoming harder to navigate than it used to be. But there are still a few phones that offer considerably more performance than their price tags suggest.
title: Best Phones Under Rs. 40,000 With Flagship-Grade Performance: Poco F7, Oppo K13 Turbo Pro, and More
